text: “We both know him,” said kind Elizabeth-Jane, to relieve her companion’s divined embarrassment. There was a knock at the door; literally, three full knocks and a little one at the end. “That kind of knock means half-and-half—somebody between gentle and simple,” said the corn-merchant to himself. “I shouldn’t wonder therefore if it is he.” In a few seconds surely enough Donald walked in. Lucetta was full of little fidgets and flutters, which increased Henchard’s suspicions without affording any special proof of their correctness.
